formula: candidate = base + dt * raw_rate; mean_mass = Q/N; lower-bound margin = Q - minimum_mean_mass*N.
interpretation: The printed decimal values place the candidate mean Q/N slightly below the supplied minimum mean mass before storage; the base mean is above the limit and the raw increment ratio is below it. This arithmetic is consistent with source-stage mean-bound failure. It does not identify the source producer/operator or establish that a common linear PBL raw-mean boundary generated these tokens.
limitations: Inputs are printed decimal approximations, not exact captured binary64 operands.
No source operator mapping is inferred from dimensions or from the quotient.
No conclusion about storage, transport, pairwise exclusive cause, or final inventory loss.
No same-arm area-weighted history/activity summary: both native arms closed INCOMPLETE at the T3/RK3 source-stage pair gate, per parent-provided run status.
scope: Independent decimal arithmetic check of parent-supplied printed source-stage tokens for a failed C12 candidate; not a native transaction replay.
